caption: The drawing features a single round object positioned near the center of the otherwise blank, beige background. The object is cylindrical with a light brown exterior and a darker circular top surface. The top of the object is decorated with a symmetrical pattern consisting of six leaf-like shapes arranged in a radial fashion, each with dark green, finely detailed veins. The rim of the top is outlined with a border that has evenly spaced, small, dark markings. The object casts no noticeable shadow and occupies the central lower portion of the drawing, leaving ample empty space around it. The overall color palette consists of shades of brown, beige, and dark green.
title: Butter Mold
